arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: CIC Services argues the IRS notice is a rule. It claims the agency failed to follow notice-and-comment procedures.
The government argues the notice imposes tax penalties. It claims the Anti-Injunction Act bars the lawsuit.
CIC Services argues the government asks citizens to violate the tax code. It rejects the pay-now-litigate-later approach.
The government argues the complaint seeks to restrain tax collection. It claims this triggers the Anti-Injunction Act.
